# USA Copier Movers - full reference

Canonical site: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/
Summary: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/llms.txt

USA Copier Movers is an American-owned copier shipping and moving company based at 2208 Station Rd, North Chesterfield, VA 23234. It moves and ships copiers, multifunction printers (MFPs), printers and other office equipment for businesses, schools, dealers and leasing companies: lease returns, office relocations, dealer freight, liftgate and white glove delivery, and storage.

Service area: Richmond, Hampton Roads (Virginia Beach and Norfolk), Northern Virginia, Washington, DC and Baltimore directly, plus the rest of Virginia; copiers are shipped to and from all 50 states and internationally.

How to get a quote: request a free quote online at https://www.usacopiermovers.com/#quote or call (866) 216-7742. Pricing depends on distance, machine size and weight, crating and delivery requirements, so it is quoted per move.

Phone: (866) 216-7742
Email: copierleasereturn@highvalueproductshipping.com
Address: 2208 Station Rd, North Chesterfield, VA 23234
Quote page: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/#quote

## About

### About USA Copier Movers
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/about.html
Updated: 2026-11-18

USA Copier Movers moves and ships copiers, MFPs, printers and other office equipment for businesses, schools, dealers and leasing companies. We are based at 2208 Station Rd in North Chesterfield, Virginia, serve the I-95 corridor directly, and ship to and from all 50 states. Call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote.

## Home page FAQs

Q: How much does it cost to ship a copier?
A: Cost depends on distance, weight, crating needs, and whether you need liftgate or inside delivery. Call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote and we'll give you a firm price before you book. Our copier shipping cost guide explains every pricing factor.

Q: Do you handle quarterly copier lease returns?
A: Yes — we specialize in scheduled, recurring lease-return shipments for dealers and end users. Email copierleasereturn@highvalueproductshipping.com to set up a standing quarterly pickup.

Q: Which copier brands can you ship?
A: All major brands — Canon, Xerox, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Sharp, Kyocera, Toshiba, HP, and Lexmark — in any size, from desktop units to production printers.

Q: How should I prepare my copier before pickup?
A: Wipe the internal hard drive, remove toner and staple cartridges, and engage the scanner lock if your model has one. We handle wrapping, palletizing, and loading. See our full copier prep checklist.

Q: Do you provide packaging and crating?
A: Yes. Every machine is wrapped, padded, and secured before it leaves the building, and crated when the equipment or lease return terms require it.

Q: Can you pick up or deliver inside the building?
A: Yes. White-glove liftgate service and inside pickup or placement are available for offices without a loading dock. Let us know about stairs, elevators, or tight doorways when you request a quote.

Q: How long does it take to ship a copier?
A: It depends on distance and service level. We confirm your pickup window and an estimated delivery date with your quote, and expedited scheduling is available for deadline-driven moves.

Q: Do you work with leasing companies and dealers?
A: Yes — we support copier dealers and leasing companies with ongoing, multi-unit shipping schedules, not just one-time moves.

Q: Do you ship copiers internationally?
A: Yes — in addition to nationwide U.S. delivery, we handle international copier shipments, including export crating and freight-forwarder coordination. Read domestic vs. international copier shipping for details.

# Services

## Nationwide Copier Freight Shipping With Liftgate and Inside Delivery
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/copier-freight-shipping-nationwide
Updated: 2026-11-18

USA Copier Movers arranges nationwide copier freight shipping to and from every state, covering inside pickup, long-distance transport and inside delivery. Liftgate service replaces a loading dock at either end, and copiers stay upright, either strapped to a pallet for shared freight or on a dedicated truck. Call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote.

Q: How much does it cost to ship a copier across the country?
A: We don't publish a set price because cost depends on distance, the copier's size and weight, crating, and whether you need liftgate or inside delivery. On long routes, palletized shared freight can cost less than a dedicated truck. Call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote for a firm price before you book.

Q: How long does nationwide copier freight shipping take?
A: It depends on distance and service level. We confirm your pickup window and an estimated delivery date with your quote, and expedited scheduling is available for deadline-driven moves. Shared freight involves more handling and longer transit times than a dedicated truck.

Q: Do you ship copiers to all 50 states?
A: Yes. We arrange copier freight shipping to and from every state.

Q: Can you pick up and deliver a copier without a loading dock?
A: Yes. Liftgate service is available at pickup and delivery, so a loading dock is not needed, and inside delivery places the copier in the room you choose.

Q: Is a copier insured during freight shipping?
A: Yes. Copier freight we ship is fully insured, and the machine is wrapped, padded or crated before it leaves the building.

Q: What is liftgate delivery for a copier?
A: A liftgate is a powered platform on the back of the truck that lowers the copier to the ground. It is needed at any address without a loading dock.

Q: Can the copier be delivered inside the building?
A: Yes. With inside delivery, the copier is brought into the building and placed in the room you choose instead of being left at the curb or dock.

Q: Does a copier have to be on a pallet for freight shipping?
A: For shared long-distance freight, copiers are usually strapped to a pallet and wrapped. Dedicated truck moves may not require a pallet.

Q: Can copiers be shipped lying on their side?
A: No. Copiers should stay upright during transport to avoid damage to internal components.

## Copier Lease Return Shipping and Pickup
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/copier-lease-return-shipping
Updated: 2026-11-18

USA Copier Movers picks up off-lease copiers from inside your office anywhere in the U.S. and delivers them to the return address your leasing company or dealer provides, with the RA number attached and delivery confirmation sent to you. Book one to two weeks before your deadline: call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote.

Q: How much does copier lease return shipping cost?
A: We don't publish a set price because cost depends on distance, the copier's size and weight, crating, and whether you need liftgate or inside delivery. Have your RA number, return address and deadline ready so the quote matches the job. Call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote for a firm price before you book.

Q: How long does a copier lease return take?
A: It depends on distance and service level. We confirm your pickup window and an estimated delivery date with your quote, and expedited scheduling is available for deadline-driven moves. We recommend booking one to two weeks before your return deadline; call if your deadline is sooner.

Q: Do you return copiers to any state?
A: Yes. We pick up off-lease copiers anywhere in the U.S. and deliver them to the return address in any state.

Q: Do you handle quarterly or recurring copier lease returns?
A: Yes. We set up standing quarterly or monthly pickup schedules for dealers, leasing companies and end users, including multi-location consolidation. Email copierleasereturn@highvalueproductshipping.com or call (866) 216-7742.

Q: How is the copier protected on the way back?
A: We keep the copier upright, wrap exposed surfaces, secure doors and trays, and strap it in rather than stacking freight on top. Your photos before pickup plus our delivery confirmation document its condition.

Q: Who arranges the copier lease return shipping?
A: Policies vary. Some leasing companies arrange the pickup themselves, but many leave it to the customer. If you are responsible for getting the machine back, we can handle the pickup and delivery to the return address.

Q: What information do I need for a lease return pickup?
A: The copier make and model, your pickup address with floor and elevator details, the return address, the return authorization number and the deadline from your leasing company.

Q: How far ahead should I schedule a lease return?
A: We recommend booking one to two weeks before your return deadline to allow for building scheduling and transit time. Call if your deadline is sooner.

Q: Can you pick up lease returns from multiple office locations?
A: Yes. We can collect copiers from several branches, consolidate them and deliver them together to the return warehouse.

## How Much Does It Cost to Ship a Copier?
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/copier-shipping-cost
Updated: 2026-11-18

There is no single price to ship a copier. Cost depends on the machine's size and weight, distance and route, how it travels, access at pickup and delivery, packaging, timing and the number of machines. USA Copier Movers quotes each shipment individually, so call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote for a firm price.

Q: How much does it cost to ship a copier?
A: It depends on the machine and the job, so we don't publish prices that would not match your shipment. Send the make and model, both addresses, access details, accessories, dates and photos, then call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote for a firm price.

Q: How long does copier shipping take?
A: It depends on distance and service level. We confirm your pickup window and an estimated delivery date with your quote, and expedited scheduling is available for deadline-driven moves. Shared freight involves more handling and longer transit times than a dedicated truck.

Q: Do you ship copiers nationwide?
A: Yes. We ship copiers to and from all 50 states and handle international shipments as well.

Q: Is it cheaper to ship a copier on a shared freight truck?
A: For long routes, palletized shared freight can cost less than a dedicated truck, but it involves more handling and longer transit times.

Q: Does shipping multiple copiers lower the cost per machine?
A: Usually, yes. Consolidating several copiers on one trip typically lowers the cost per machine compared with separate shipments.

Q: Why don't you list prices for copier shipping?
A: Copier shipping costs depend on the machine, distance, access at both ends, packaging and timing. A published number would not match most real jobs, so we quote each shipment individually.

Q: What has the biggest effect on the cost to ship a copier?
A: Weight and size, distance, and access at pickup and delivery have the largest effect. Stairs, inside delivery and the lack of a loading dock all add time and equipment.

Q: What do I need to get a copier shipping quote?
A: The copier make and model, both addresses, access details at each end, accessories, preferred dates and photos. Call (866) 216-7742 or use the quote form.

URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/large-format-printer-moving
Updated: 2026-11-18

USA Copier Movers moves wide-format printers, engineering plotters and wide-format scanners for architecture, engineering, construction, school, sign and print customers. We check machine dimensions and the route first, then move it locally or crate or palletize it as freight with liftgate and inside delivery in another state. Call (866) 216-7742.

Q: How much does it cost to move a large format printer?
A: Pricing depends on the machine, its width, whether it sits on a stand, the distance and the path at each location, so we quote each move individually. Call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote.

Q: How long does large format printer shipping take?
A: It depends on distance and service level. We confirm your pickup window and an estimated delivery date with your quote, and expedited scheduling is available for deadline-driven moves.

Q: Can you ship a large format printer to another state?
A: Yes. Wide-format printers can be crated or palletized and shipped as freight with liftgate and inside delivery at the destination.

Q: Can you move plotters together with our copiers during an office move?
A: Yes. When a design firm or engineering office relocates, we can move plotters, copiers and MFPs together as part of the same office move.

Q: Do you move plotters and wide-format printers?
A: Yes. We move engineering plotters, wide-format inkjet printers, wide-format multifunction systems and wide-format scanners.

Q: Does a plotter need to come off its stand for a move?
A: It depends on the machine and the doorways along the path. We check the dimensions and the route ahead of time and decide whether it can move on its stand.

Q: Do I need a technician before moving a wide-format printer?
A: Some manufacturers recommend a technician prepare the ink system before transport, especially for long moves. Check with your dealer or service provider before pickup.

Q: What details do you need to quote a plotter move?
A: The make and model, the machine width, whether it is on a stand, both addresses and photos of the path from the printer to the exit at each location.

## Office Copier Relocation During an Office Move
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/office-copier-relocation
Updated: 2026-11-18

USA Copier Movers provides a dedicated copier crew for office moves, working alongside your main mover or on its own. We coordinate dock times, elevator use and truck loading, move copiers before or after everything else, handle moves between floors, and place and level each machine so your IT team or dealer can reconnect it.

Q: How much does it cost to relocate office copiers?
A: Pricing depends on how many machines are moving, their size and weight, the distance and access at both offices, so we quote each move. Send your copier list, both addresses, the move date and building rules, then call (866) 216-7742 or request a free quote.

Q: How long does an office copier relocation take?
A: It depends on distance and service level. We confirm your pickup window and an estimated delivery date with your quote, and expedited scheduling is available for deadline-driven moves. We schedule the copier move around your main move day.

Q: Can you move our copiers while another company moves the rest of the office?
A: Yes. We regularly coordinate with the main office mover on dock times, elevator use and truck loading so the copier move fits into the overall schedule.

Q: Can you relocate office copiers to another state?
A: Yes. Beyond local and in-building moves, we ship copiers to and from all 50 states with liftgate and inside delivery at the new office.

Q: Should copiers be moved before or after everything else?
A: Either works. Moving them first means they are in place when staff arrive. Moving them last keeps them available at the old office until the end. We schedule around your preference.

Q: Do I need to tell my leasing company before moving a leased copier?
A: Many leases include an equipment-location clause that requires notice before a machine moves. Check your lease or ask the leasing company before move day.

Q: Will the copier be ready to use after the move?
A: We place the copier in position and level it. Your IT team or dealer then reconnects it to the network and handles any setup or service.

Q: Do you move copiers between floors in the same building?
A: Yes. In-building moves between floors or suites are a common part of our work.

We move and place the equipment; your technician handles setup and calibration. Call (866) 216-7742.

Q: How much does it cost to move a printing press?

Q: How long does printing press shipping take?
A: It depends on distance and service level. We confirm your pickup window and an estimated delivery date with your quote, and expedited scheduling is available for deadline-driven moves.

Q: Do you move printing equipment nationwide?
A: Yes. We move production printers, wide-format printers and small presses anywhere in the U.S.

Q: Should my printer be crated or palletized?
A: It depends on the machine, the distance and how fragile it is. Crating is common for long-haul and delicate equipment, and palletizing works for many shorter moves. We will recommend the right option.

Q: How do you ship a large format printer?
A: Put the printer in its transport mode if it has one, remove ink, media and loose parts, detach stands and modules, then crate or palletize it so it cannot shift. We handle the packing and transport for you.

Q: Do you provide rigging for printing presses?
A: Yes. We use rigging equipment to move heavy presses and production printers out of and into buildings.

## How to Ship or Move a Copier: Your Questions Answered

Updated: 2026-11-16

Answers to the top copier moving questions: how much it costs to ship a copier, how to move a copy machine, freight class, weight, disposal, storage and copier movers near you.

Q: How much does it cost to ship a copier?
A: It depends on distance, weight, packing and delivery services such as liftgate or inside delivery. Call (866) 216-7742 for a firm quote.

Q: Can a copy machine be laid down for transport?
A: No. Copiers should always ride upright to avoid toner spills and internal damage.

Q: What freight class is a copier?
A: Copier freight class is usually based on density. Send the dimensions and weight for an exact class and quote.

## How Much Does It Cost to Ship a Copier? 2026 Price Guide
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/blog/copier-shipping-cost-guide.html
Updated: 2026-11-01

How much does it cost to ship a copier in 2026? Typical ranges by size and distance, what liftgate, crating, and fuel add, and how to get a firm quote. Call (866) 216-7742.

Q: How much does it cost to ship a copier?
A: Most copier shipments fall between about $150 and $1,500. A local desktop copier under 100 miles typically runs $150 to $350, a regional multifunction device $300 to $650, and a cross-country production printer $600 to $1,500 or more. Weight, distance, packaging, access, and timing set the final price.

Q: Is it cheaper to ship a copier on a pallet or with white glove service?
A: Palletized dock-to-dock freight is the least expensive option. White glove service costs more because it adds inside pickup and delivery, extra labor, and placement in the room you choose, but offices without a loading dock usually need it.

Q: Does a liftgate add to the cost of copier shipping?
A: Yes. When either address has no loading dock, the truck needs a liftgate to lower the copier safely to the ground, and that is priced as an accessorial. Tell us about dock access at both ends so it is in your quote from the start.

Q: Do fuel prices change copier shipping costs?
A: Yes. Fuel surcharges are built into freight pricing, so higher diesel prices raise long-distance quotes more than local moves. Booking early and allowing a flexible pickup window can help.

Q: Does crating a copier cost extra?
A: Yes. A custom wooden crate costs more than blanket wrap and pallet securing, but it is usually worth it for international shipments, lease returns that will be inspected, and high-value production printers.

Q: How do I get an exact copier shipping quote?
A: Call (866) 216-7742 or use the quote form at https://www.usacopiermovers.com/#quote with the make and model, pickup and delivery ZIP codes, dock access at both ends, weight and dimensions if you have them, photos, and your requested pickup date.

## Everyone's Scared AI Will Take Their Job. It's Coming for Your Shipping Bill First.
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/blog/diesel-prices-ai-shipping-costs-2026.html
Updated: 2026-09-22

Diesel just hit a record $6.53 a gallon. Here's why (yes, AI is part of it), what it means for freight rates in 2026, and 6 ways to keep your shipping costs down.

Q: Why are diesel prices so high in 2026?
A: Mainly because the closure of the Strait of Hormuz cut global oil flows and U.S. refineries are running near full capacity. Rising diesel demand from AI data center backup generators adds pressure on top of that.

Q: Will shipping costs go up because of diesel prices?
A: Yes. Most carriers add a fuel surcharge that is tied to the weekly U.S. diesel average, so when diesel rises, the fuel portion of a freight quote rises with it.

Q: How can I lower my shipping costs when fuel is expensive?
A: Be flexible on pickup dates, ship multiple items together, give accurate weights and dimensions, confirm dock or liftgate access up front, and ask for an all-in quote that includes fuel.

## Election Day, Gas Prices and Moving Your Copiers: What to Expect This Fall
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/blog/election-gas-prices-copier-moving-costs.html
Updated: 2026-10-15

Fuel is a top issue heading into the Nov. 3 midterms. Where gas and diesel prices stand, what it means for copier and office equipment moves, and how to save.

## How to Move a Copier Safely: Step-by-Step Guide for Office Moves
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/blog/how-to-move-a-copier.html
Updated: 2026-11-01

How to move a copier safely: lease checks, route planning, prep, upright transport, and setup for moves to another floor, building, or state. Free quote: (866) 216-7742.

Q: How much does a copier weigh?
A: It depends on the class of machine. Desktop multifunction printers are often under 100 lbs, floor-standing office copiers commonly weigh about 150 to 400+ lbs, and production printers can go well past 500 lbs. The spec sheet for your model lists the exact weight.

Q: Can a copier be moved on its side?
A: No. A copier should stay upright the whole way. Laying it down can shift internal parts, knock the scanner out of alignment, and spill residual toner inside the machine.

Q: How much does it cost to move a copier?
A: Local copier moves are priced mostly on labor, stairs, and equipment. Long-distance moves are priced on weight, distance, packaging, and the delivery service you need. Our copier shipping cost guide breaks down each factor, or request a free quote for a firm price.

Q: Do I need to tell my leasing company before moving a copier?
A: Usually, yes. Many copier leases include an equipment-location clause that requires notice before the machine changes address. Check your agreement and call your leasing company or dealer before moving day.

Q: Do copier movers wipe the hard drive?
A: We do not. Data wiping is not a service USA Copier Movers provides. If the drive needs to be cleared, have your dealer, leasing company, or IT provider run the manufacturer's overwrite before pickup. We handle the physical move: wrapping, loading, transport, and placement.

Q: How long does it take to move a copier?
A: A local move within the same metro area is often done in a single morning. Long-distance and cross-country moves depend on distance and service level; we confirm your pickup window and an estimated delivery date with your quote, and expedited scheduling is available.

## Copier Lease Return Shipping: The Complete Quarterly & End-of-Lease Guide
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/blog/quarterly-copier-lease-returns.html
Updated: 2026-11-01

How to return a leased copier: return authorization, meter reading, inspection checklist, packaging, and standing quarterly pickups for every major brand. Free quote: (866) 216-7742.

Q: Who pays to ship a leased copier back?
A: It depends on your lease. Many leases make the customer responsible for return freight to the leasing company's designated address. Check the end-of-term section of your agreement before the return window opens.

Q: How far ahead should I book a copier lease return pickup?
A: Book at least 1 to 2 weeks before your return deadline. For multi-unit or multi-location quarterly batches, 3 to 4 weeks gives time to consolidate pickups and keep costs down.

Q: Do I need to crate a copier for a lease return?
A: Not always. Many returns ship stretch-wrapped and padded on a pallet. Crating is recommended for long-haul, international, or high-value production units, or whenever the leasing company requires it.

Q: Do you wipe the copier hard drive before a lease return?
A: No. Data wiping is not a service we provide. If your lease or security policy requires the drive to be cleared, have your dealer, leasing company, or IT provider run the overwrite and issue any certificate before pickup day.

Q: Can you pick up leased copiers from several offices at once?
A: Yes. We consolidate multi-location pickups onto one schedule and one invoice.

Q: Which brands do you ship for lease returns?
A: All major brands, including Canon, Xerox, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Sharp, Kyocera, Toshiba, HP, and Lexmark.

## 2026 Year-End Copier Rush: Lease Returns, Office Moves and What It Means for Shipping
URL: https://www.usacopiermovers.com/blog/year-end-copier-moving-trends-2026.html
Updated: 2026-11-16

Why copier moving peaks at year-end in 2026: copier lease returns, office moves, smaller fleets and holiday freight. Costs, prep checklist and copier movers near you.

Q: Why is the end of the year busy for copier moving?
A: Copier leases often end at the end of the year, offices move when commercial leases renew, and dealers deliver new machines before December 31, so copier lease returns, removals and deliveries all peak in Q4 and Q1.

Q: How much does it cost to ship a copier?
A: It depends on distance, weight, packing and services such as liftgate or inside delivery. Call (866) 216-7742 for a firm copier shipping quote.

Q: Do businesses switch copiers when moving offices?
A: Many do. An office move is a common time to return a leased copier and bring in a new one. A copier moving company can remove the old machine and deliver the new one.

Q: Can a copy machine be laid down for transport?
A: No. Copiers should always ride upright to avoid toner spills and damage to the scanner and internal parts.
